roots.description: Operator creates product (should be PLANNER/MANAGER/ADMIN only)
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: POST /products on /products restricted to authorized roles only

roots.description: Globex manager lists work centers (should only see globex)
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: /work-centers listing must be org-scoped (multi-tenant isolation)

roots.description: Release a COMPLETED work order (should be rejected)
Create receipt for non-COMPLETED work order
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: Work Order must be COMPLETED before receipt creation

roots.description: Create work order with non-existent BOM/Routing
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: Product must have active BOM and Routing (precondition)
API_SPEC/BUSINESS_RULES: Issue quantity must not exceed reserved_quantity - issued_quantity

roots.description: Duplicate sales order with same order_ref (should be 409)
Cancel WO does not release material reservations
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: Cancel must release all material reservations

roots.description: Create WO with planned_start after planned_end
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC/BUSINESS_RULES: planned_start must be earlier than planned_end

roots.description: Update WO with stale version (should be 409)
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: /work-orders requires version check (optimistic locking, 409 on mismatch)

roots.description: Bulk issue with invalid reservation (should be atomic)
roots.constraint_ref: API_SPEC: /material-issues/bulk-issue batch semantics: atomic (if any fails, none created)
